src: U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2017 +1 more
s: Swadesh Darshan Scheme launched by Government of India does not include development of which of the following tourist circuit?
x:
Most keys (UPPCS 2017): Sufi circuit. Strictly: the Sufi circuit is one of the 15 thematic circuits of Swadesh Darshan (Lok Sabha replies 2019, 2021), so none of the options is excluded today.
Sufi circuit was not among the early circuits — now Swadesh Darshan lists 15 circuits including Sufi and Tirthankar (Ministry of Tourism, Lok Sabha replies 2019/2021)
The UPPCS 2017 key treats the Sufi circuit as the one not covered; Heritage, Ramayana and Coastal circuits were in the original list (now Sufi is one of the 15 circuits too).
